name: gooey-input
blurb: Search input that expands and animates with a gooey morphing effect.
description: An animated search input using Framer Motion that collapses to a circular button and smoothly expands into a full field, with an SVG gooey filter creating a liquid morphing visual effect.
use_when: Building minimalist search interfaces or hero sections where visual polish and space efficiency enhance the experience.
avoid_when: On projects requiring prefers-reduced-motion compliance or where animation overhead matters.
a11y: Input is properly labeled and disabled state is respected, but the expand/collapse animation does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
